question.text:
The haemoglobin from red blood corpuscles of most mammals contains approximately 0.33% of iron by mass. The molecular mass of haemoglobin is 67200. The number of iron atoms in each molecular of heamoglobin is [Given : Atomic mass of Fe = 56 g/mol]
Report your answer by rounding it upto nearest whole number.

solution.text:
100 g Haemoglobin =0.33 g Fe
67200 g Haemoglobin =0.33×67200100=221.76
Number of iron atoms per molecules of haemoglobin =221.7656=4
